title: Research Methods for Policy and Practice
description: Introduces students to essential skills and components of the research process. Key issues in qualitative and quantitative research ethics and design are explored, including: ways of knowing, research and data validity, measurement, qualitative methods, sampling, survey research techniques, questionnaire design, research design, measures of central tendency, dispersion, correlation, and data analysis.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 502A, ADMN 557.
